summary: Iteration 2: Comprehensive testing of notifications, permissions (izin), photo upload, and PDF export features. Backend 38/38 tests passing (16 new + 22 regression). Frontend was COMPLETELY BROKEN due to JSX syntax error in more.tsx (duplicated dangling add-match-btn code) AND missing IZIN ABSEN banner JSX. I fixed both (file would not bundle, blocking all UI). After fix: parent flow (bell badge -> /notifications -> BACA SEMUA, IZIN ABSEN banner -> /permissions -> + add modal with child/session/type/reason) and coach flow (SETUJUI approve, SPP export icon) verified end-to-end via mobile viewport playwright.

ui_bugs.issue: BLOCKER: JSX SyntaxError - duplicated 'add-match-btn' TouchableOpacity dangling inside matches.map render caused 'Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for <View>. (120:10)'. Entire app could not bundle, browser showed red Metro error overlay. FIXED by removing dangling duplicated block.

IZIN ABSEN banner styles (izinBanner/izinTitle/izinSub) were defined but the corresponding JSX block was missing entirely - parents and coaches had no entry point to /permissions. FIXED by adding TouchableOpacity izin-banner above ScrollView that routes to /(app)/permissions.

rca_of_issue: BUG: Frontend entirely broken at iteration 2 hand-off. REPRO: open https://soccer-school-7.preview.emergentagent.com -> Metro red screen 'SyntaxError /app/frontend/app/(app)/(tabs)/more.tsx Expected corresponding JSX closing tag for <View>. (120:10)'. ROOT CAUSE: in more.tsx, inside the matches branch (matches.map((m) => (...))), an entire 'add-match-btn' TouchableOpacity block from the canEdit guard was duplicated INSIDE the per-match <View style={styles.matchRow}>, then followed by a stray '{matches.length === 0 ? ...}' and the real per-match render. This produced unbalanced JSX (extra ')}' and '</>') and the bundler failed. ADDITIONALLY: the IZIN ABSEN banner — promised in the test request — had its styles (izinBanner/izinTitle/izinSub) declared in StyleSheet.create but no JSX usage at all, so parents had no UI entry to /permissions through the LAINNYA tab. MITIGATION: (1) removed the duplicated dangling JSX, (2) inserted the missing IZIN ABSEN TouchableOpacity banner above ScrollView with onPress -> router.push('/(app)/permissions') and testID='izin-banner', label adapts by role. After fix, app bundled successfully and all flows in the test request rendered correctly.
